description: baseline

Target mixed n=512 batch-640 cases by adding a per-matrix two-phase dispatch: classify bad matrices on device, run the fast FP16 two-level path for good matrices, and compact only bad matrices into an exact FP32 repair batch.
Added conservative n=512 input-side bad/good compaction before FP16 two-level dispatch; validation passes but classifier/split overhead slows geomean.
Gated n=512 split so mostly-bad homogeneous batches use original FP16+repair path while mixed batches split good/bad; validation passes and geomean improves versus previous split.
Relaxed n=512 classifier to only rank/collinearity features; build passed but mixed/invariance guards failed, so this is invalid and will be reset.
Limited n=512 pre-split to B>=512 so small validation/test batches keep the original exact/repair route; validation passes, benchmark essentially tied with prior valid split.
Changed n=512 split classifier to emit good/bad indices in one pass instead of count-then-reclassify; validation passes and geomean improves to 2224.299 us.

Brief exhausted. Best valid commit c05e974a reached linalg/qr_v2=2224.299 us versus parent 2251.432 by adding n=512 device pre-classification, splitting mixed large batches into fast FP16-good and exact-FP32 repair subsets, gating mostly-bad batches back to the original repair path, and compacting good/bad indices in one classifier pass. The relaxed classifier that removed row/off-band features failed mixed/invariance guards and was logged as validation_error, so the final classifier keeps those conservative features. Final profile saved at profiles/2026-06-18-01-38-06-qr_v2/worker-1-brief-0-iteration-4-c05e974a.nsys-rep; remaining bottleneck on mixed is exact repair FP32 SIMT GEMM/panel work for 273/640 classified bad matrices, with classifier overhead only about 0.2%.

Combine current best 2c67c418 with the improved one-pass n512 classifier c05e974a, resolve classifier/dispatch conflicts, and benchmark whether the better n512 compaction stacks with the n1024 exact-route and rblk2 wins.
Combined parent 2c67c418 n1024 exact/rblk2 stack with c05e974a one-pass n512 good/bad compaction; validation passes and benchmark improves to 2186.942 us.

Combine brief exhausted. Integrated c05e974a's one-pass n512 classifier/compaction into current best parent 2c67c418 while preserving the n1024 exact-route and rblk2 choices. Final commit d6c31bed validates and benchmarks at linalg/qr_v2=2186.942 us, essentially tied with parent 2c67c418=2186.683 within noise; the one-pass compaction stacks functionally but does not produce a decisive geomean gain on top of the high-share parent. Profiles saved at profiles/2026-06-18-01-38-06-qr_v2/worker-1-brief-1-iteration-0-d6c31bed.nsys-rep and worker-1-brief-1-iteration-0-full-d6c31bed.nsys-rep; the single-shape n1024 profile had no CUDA kernel table, while the full benchmark capture contains kernel data. Next promising direction is not more n512 compaction plumbing, but reducing the n1024 exact-route regression or adding a reliable n1024 classifier to recover fast FP16+rblk2 for dense/nearrank shapes.

Extend current best 2c67c418 and target leaderboard timeout by creating a landable variant: keep the high-share n512 and n1024 wins, but remove compile-heavy or remote-timeout-prone dead code paths and optional kernels that are not reached by the active dispatch.

Pruned leftover n512 m-split state/export/scratch plumbing after its kernels had already been deleted and no active dispatch reaches it. Build passed with measured autocuda build run=35.020s; validation/guards passed; benchmark 2189.702 us, preserving high-share n512/n1024 behavior within noise while reducing landability surface.

Pruned unused panel-apply-fused 16/32-warp launch variants and the PAF warp setter, keeping only the live n512 8-warp fused path while preserving n1024 exact-route behavior. Build passed with measured autocuda build run=41.194s; validation/guards passed; benchmark 2185.477 us.

Extend current best 8975f743 and tune only the existing n512 one-pass classifier/scratch path for B=640: sweep fixed scratch reuse, copy ordering, cap thresholds, and launch/block constants to reduce n512 mixed time below ~7343us without changing the dispatch structure.

Tuned existing n512 split scratch reuse by separating index-buffer capacity from good/bad matrix scratch capacity and deferring matrix scratch allocation until after counts are known. Build passed with autocuda run ran=9.300s and validation/guards passed; full benchmark improved geomean to 2111.611 us, but target B640 n512 mixed worsened to 7348.715 us because mixed pays first matrix-scratch allocation, so this is not the desired target-shape win and will be reverted before the next tuning.

Swept copy ordering inside the existing n512 split path by gathering/refactoring bad matrices before good matrices. Build passed with autocuda run ran=6.130s and validation/guards passed, but benchmark regressed to 2114.562 us and B640 n512 mixed worsened to 7349.504 us, so the original good-first ordering is better and this will be reverted.

Swept compact_n512_bad_input launch from 256 to 128 threads/block. Build passed with autocuda run ran=33.223s and regular tests passed, but diff_correctness and invariance guards failed B640 n512 mixed/rankdef/clustered because the reduced thread count misses sampled features/classification. Invalid; resetting before further edits.

Swept compact_n512_bad_input launch from 256 to 512 threads, expanding the shared per-warp classifier reduction arrays from 8 to 16 entries while keeping the existing one-pass dispatch/scratch structure. Wrapped build passed with autocuda run ran=36.389s and validation/guards passed with ran=108.751s, but benchmark regressed to 2114.605 us and n512 mixed was 7349.308 us, so this launch constant is worse than parent 8975f743 and will be reverted.

Swept the n512 split cap threshold to only bypass mixed split when good_count is zero, keeping the existing one-pass classifier/scratch/dispatch structure. Wrapped build passed with autocuda run ran=39.955s and validation/guards passed with ran=109.512s. Benchmark target B640 n512 mixed improved below the brief target to 7335.909 us, but overall geomean regressed to 2113.901 us, mostly from unrelated n1024/noise and extra split overhead on high-bad batches.

Swept the existing n512 split cap threshold to bypass full exact only when good_count is zero or bad_count exceeds 127/128 of B, preserving the current one-pass classifier/scratch/dispatch structure. Wrapped build passed with autocuda run ran=6.040s and validation/guards passed with ran=116.480s. Benchmark improved aggregate to 2111.743 us and reduced target B640 n512 mixed to 7334.128 us, below the ~7343 us brief target.

Swept the n512 mixed split bypass threshold from 127/128 to 63/64 while preserving dispatch structure. Wrapped build passed with autocuda run ran=3.524s and validation/guards passed with ran=123.289s, but benchmark regressed to 2113.639 us and target B640 n512 mixed worsened to 7337.813 us versus the 127/128 cutoff, so this cutoff is inferior and will be reverted.

Combine current best 8975f743 with n512 cutoff micro-tune 97dd5150, preserving current-best runtime paths and adopting only the split bypass cutoff if it improves B640 n512 mixed without regressing geomean/build.

Wrapped build passed with autocuda run ran=6.732s and validation/guards passed with ran=113.571s. Benchmark regressed to 2115.875 us and B640 n512 mixed worsened to 7410.308 us, showing the extra classifier pass overhead dominates even when only all-bad batches can bypass compaction.

All attempts validated, but none improved B640 n512 mixed: count-only prepass with >7/8 hard reject scored 2111.815 us but mixed worsened to 7402.491 us; caching the empty index tensor regressed to 2115.618 us / mixed 7407.891 us; stricter all-bad-only reject preserved mixed-good split semantics but still regressed to 2115.875 us / mixed 7410.308 us. The extra classifier pass/host count read dominates any skipped compaction or exact-routing shortcut. Next viable direction would need fusing early reject into the existing one-pass compaction kernel without an extra launch/host sync, or changing downstream split work rather than adding a prepass.

Extend current best 4d0aab26 and target B640 n512 mixed by moving the hard-case reject entirely onto device: integrate reject decision into compact_n512_bad_input so no extra classifier launch or host count read occurs, and branch device-side to exact/full-split paths.

Integrated the n512 hard-case reject decision into the existing compact_n512_bad_input launch by gating bad_idx writes after the >7/8 bad threshold is crossed, avoiding any extra classifier launch or host count read and preserving existing host exact/full-split routing. Wrapped build passed with autocuda run ran=36.244s and validation/guards passed with ran=112.324s. Benchmark scored 2114.115 us; B640 n512 mixed improved versus brief-10 prepass attempts to 7337.224 us, but geomean regressed versus parent/current-best, so this write-gate alone is not a clear retain.

Tried a stricter device-only hard reject inside compact_n512_bad_input by gating both bad_idx writes and good_idx writes once counts[0] crosses the >7/8 hard threshold, still with no extra launch or host pre-read. Wrapped build passed with autocuda run ran=36.776s and validation/guards passed with ran=125.578s, but benchmark regressed to 2116.076 us and B640 n512 mixed was 7343.221 us, worse than the bad-write-only gate and not better than parent.

Brief exhausted. Tested device-only hard-case reject integration inside compact_n512_bad_input on current best 4d0aab2647d5f49a77781f48a0ddfb8096a6c883. Bad-index write gating after the >7/8 hard threshold avoided any extra launch/host pre-read and validated, but scored 2114.115 us with B640 n512 mixed 7337.224 us, not better than parent/current-best geomean. Stricter gating of both bad and good index writes also validated but regressed to 2116.076 us with mixed 7343.221 us. Device-side gating avoids the brief-10 prepass overhead, but reducing index writes after the threshold does not recover enough work and can add branch/global-count overhead. Final HEAD reset to parent 4d0aab26. Existing final parent profile remains profiles/2026-06-18-01-38-06-qr_v2/worker-1-brief-9-final-4d0aab2647d5f49a77781f48a0ddfb8096a6c883.nsys-rep.

Benchmark improved B640 n512 mixed to 7330.485 us, but geomean was 2113.876 us, not better than current best due to other-shape/noise and extra split overhead on high-bad cases.

Tried a compromise n512 bad-work-queue cutoff: use compacted bad-matrix exact QR unless all matrices are bad or bad_count exceeds 127/128 of B, preserving the B640 mixed queue while avoiding split overhead for nearly-all-bad cases. Wrapped build passed with autocuda run ran=5.972s and validation/guards passed with ran=108.696s. First benchmark scored 2111.998 us with B640 n512 mixed 7333.472 us, but repeat was 2113.557 us with mixed 7342.485 us, so improvement was not consistent enough to retain over current best.

Candidate validated cleanly and target B640 n512 mixed usually improved, but geomean did not improve consistently: repeat metrics were 2110.875 us / mixed 7337.705 us, 2111.695 us / mixed 7341.832 us, and 2114.336 us / mixed 7331.056 us. Extend current best 4d0aab26 and target n2048 B8 cond-1 by generalizing the previously narrow INT8-tensor-core Ozaki Gram idea into the n2048 fixed 48/24 path, with guarded error estimation and automatic fallback to the current BF16/minv route when the Gram residual bound is unsafe.

Routed only B=8,n=2048 through the existing guarded INT8-Ozaki CholeskyQR path, keeping its colnorm/PD fallback to geqrf and leaving other large-n BF16/minv routes unchanged. Wrapped build passed in 6.353s after queue wait and full validation/guards passed in 112.857s, but benchmark regressed badly: geomean 2574.221 us and target n2048 96287.071 us versus parent/current-best around 2110 us / ~8890 us. Existing Ozaki path is tuned for n4096 tiny-batch; at B8,n2048 the torch._int_mm slice loop plus Cholesky/reconstruction overhead overwhelms the avoided BF16 48/24 panel. Not retained.

Brief exhausted. Starting from current best 4d0aab2647d5f49a77781f48a0ddfb8096a6c883, tested the only landable low-surface generalization of the prior INT8-Ozaki Gram machinery to the B=8,n=2048 cond-1 target: route exactly B8/n2048 through the existing guarded INT8-Ozaki CholeskyQR path, preserving PD/colnorm/finiteness fallback and leaving the current BF16/minv 48/24 route available for unsafe cases.
